deadline.value: Apply by December 15 for UWM Graduate Fellowship consideration; January 15 for other TA and RA funding.
deadline.quote: If you would like to be considered for any UWM Graduate Fellowship, be sure to submit your application by December 15 for Fall admission.

gre_general.value: The department no longer requires GRE scores.
gre_general.quote: The Department of Geosciences no longer requires submission of GRE scores.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: No advisor must be named before applying, though contacting potential advisors helps.
supervisor.quote: You are not required to identify an advisor (supervisor) before applying

funding.value: Most students are admitted with significant support as a TA, RA or fellowship.
funding.quote: Most of our students are admitted with significant financial support as a teaching assistant (TA), research assistant (RA), or fellowship.

entry_route.value: The fetched page does not state a degree requirement.

fee_waiver.value: Open-house waivers, plus a few waivers for US citizens and permanent residents only.
fee_waiver.quote: A limited number of additional application fee waivers are available for U.S. citizens and permanent residents only.

notes: The department's own deadlines are the fellowship (Dec 15) and funding (Jan 15) dates; the earlier one is shown.
